assets_owner_account_instrument_unique.name: assets_owner_account_instrument_unique
assets_owner_account_instrument_unique.where: "assets"."canonical_owner_user_id" is not null and "assets"."account_id" is not null and "assets"."ticker" is not null

auth_identities_disabled_state_check.name: auth_identities_disabled_state_check
auth_identities_disabled_state_check.value: ("auth_identities"."status" = 'active' and "auth_identities"."disabled_at" is null) or ("auth_identities"."status" = 'disabled' and "auth_identities"."disabled_at" is not null)

daily_portfolio_snapshots_generated_owne.name: daily_portfolio_snapshots_generated_owner_check
daily_portfolio_snapshots_generated_owne.value: "daily_portfolio_snapshots"."source" <> 'varda_manual_daily_snapshot' or ("daily_portfolio_snapshots"."canonical_owner_user_id" is not null and (("daily_portfolio_snapshots"."account" = 'all' and "daily_portfolio_snapshots"."account_id" is null) or ("daily_portfolio_snapshots"."account" <> 'all' and "daily_portfolio_snapshots"."account_id" is not null)))

daily_position_snapshots_date_account_as.name: daily_position_snapshots_date_account_asset_source_unique
daily_position_snapshots_date_account_as.where: "daily_position_snapshots"."asset_id" is not null and "daily_position_snapshots"."canonical_owner_user_id" is not null

daily_position_snapshots_generated_owner.name: daily_position_snapshots_generated_owner_check
daily_position_snapshots_generated_owner.value: "daily_position_snapshots"."source" <> 'varda_manual_daily_snapshot' or ("daily_position_snapshots"."canonical_owner_user_id" is not null and "daily_position_snapshots"."account_id" is not null and "daily_position_snapshots"."asset_id" is not null and "daily_position_snapshots"."account" <> 'all')

daily_position_snapshots_asset_identity_.name: daily_position_snapshots_asset_identity_check
daily_position_snapshots_asset_identity_.value: "daily_position_snapshots"."asset_id" is not null or "daily_position_snapshots"."legacy_asset_id" is not null

holding_lifecycle_events_transition_shap.name: holding_lifecycle_events_transition_shape_check
holding_lifecycle_events_transition_shap.value: ("holding_lifecycle_events"."event_type" = 'archived' and "holding_lifecycle_events"."previous_archived_at" is null and "holding_lifecycle_events"."resulting_archived_at" is not null) or ("holding_lifecycle_events"."event_type" = 'restored' and "holding_lifecycle_events"."previous_archived_at" is not null and "holding_lifecycle_events"."resulting_archived_at" is null)

holding_lifecycle_events_reason_check.name: holding_lifecycle_events_reason_check
holding_lifecycle_events_reason_check.value: "holding_lifecycle_events"."reason" is null or ("holding_lifecycle_events"."reason" = btrim("holding_lifecycle_events"."reason") and char_length("holding_lifecycle_events"."reason") between 1 and 500)

holding_state_corrections_reason_check.name: holding_state_corrections_reason_check
holding_state_corrections_reason_check.value: "holding_state_corrections"."reason" is null or ("holding_state_corrections"."reason" = btrim("holding_state_corrections"."reason") and char_length("holding_state_corrections"."reason") between 1 and 500)

id_pair_intent_events_identity_state_che.name: id_pair_intent_events_identity_state_check
id_pair_intent_events_identity_state_che.value: ("identity_pairing_intent_events"."event_type" = 'consumed' and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."auth_identity_id" is not null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."subject_binding_version" is not null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."subject_binding_version" = 'provider_subject_hmac_sha256_v1' and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."subject_binding" is not null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."subject_binding" ~ '^hmac-sha256-v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_planner_policy_id" is not null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_planner_policy_id" = 'initial_identity_link_planner_v1' and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_plan_binding_version" is not null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_plan_binding_version" = 'identity_link_plan_hmac_sha256_v1' and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_plan_binding" is not null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_plan_binding" ~ '^identity-link-plan-hmac-sha256-v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$') or ("identity_pairing_intent_events"."event_type" = 'revoked' and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."auth_identity_id" is null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."subject_binding_version" is null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."subject_binding" is null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_planner_policy_id" is null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_plan_binding_version" is null and "identity_pairing_intent_events"."identity_link_plan_binding" is null)

portfolio_target_events_transition_shape.name: portfolio_target_events_transition_shape_check
portfolio_target_events_transition_shape.value: ("portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."event_sequence" = 1 and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."transition_kind" = 'explicit_approval' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."previous_status" is null and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."resulting_status" = 'approved' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."replacement_revision_id" is null) or ("portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."event_sequence" = 2 and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."transition_kind" = 'revocation' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."previous_status" = 'approved' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."resulting_status" = 'revoked' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."replacement_revision_id" is null) or ("portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."event_sequence" = 2 and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."transition_kind" = 'supersession' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."previous_status" = 'approved' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."resulting_status" = 'superseded' and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."replacement_revision_id" is not null and "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."replacement_revision_id" <> "portfolio_target_policy_lifecycle_events"."approval_revision_id")

portfolio_target_revisions_scope_shape_c.name: portfolio_target_revisions_scope_shape_check
portfolio_target_revisions_scope_shape_c.value: ("portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_kind" = 'all' and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_account_id" is null and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_portfolio_group_id" is null) or ("portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_kind" = 'account' and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_account_id" is not null and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_portfolio_group_id" is null) or ("portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_kind" = 'portfolio_group' and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_account_id" is null and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."scope_portfolio_group_id" is not null)

portfolio_target_revisions_terminal_stat.name: portfolio_target_revisions_terminal_state_check
portfolio_target_revisions_terminal_stat.value: ("portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."lifecycle_status" = 'approved' and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."terminal_at" is null) or ("portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."lifecycle_status" in ('revoked', 'superseded') and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."terminal_at" is not null and "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."terminal_at" >= "portfolio_target_policy_revisions"."approved_at")

simulation_scenario_events_tenant_select.name: simulation_scenario_events_tenant_select_v1
simulation_scenario_events_tenant_select.using:
exists (
          select 1
          from "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"
          where "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."id" = "simulation_scenario_approval_lifecycle_events"."approval_revision_id"
            and "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."owner_user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '')::uuid
        )

sim_scenario_approval_revisions_terminal.name: sim_scenario_approval_revisions_terminal_state_check
sim_scenario_approval_revisions_terminal.value: ("simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."lifecycle_status" = 'approved' and "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."terminal_at" is null) or ("simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."lifecycle_status" in ('revoked', 'superseded') and "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."terminal_at" is not null and "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."terminal_at" >= "simulation_scenario_approval_revisions"."approved_at")
